hero.headline: Construction Reporting and Analytics
hero.subhead: Turn live site data into reports for every stage of your construction project. A robust construction analytics and reporting software that helps leadership identify trends, control costs, and make decisions with confidence.
checklist: One connected workspace for progress, cost, and billing
Reports pull from BOQ, DPR, and RA bills
No SQL required to build or schedule reports

features.title: Custom Report Builder
features.body: Design reports with a drag and drop interface. Pull data from across the platform, apply filters, and schedule automated distribution to stakeholders. No SQL required.

features.title: Real-Time Multi-Project Visibility
features.body: Access live dashboards that consolidate progress, costs, labour, materials, subcontractors, and billing in one place. Stop waiting for month-end reconciliations to understand project health.
bullets: Track vendor performance and rate trends

faqs.q: How long does it take to implement?
faqs.a: Most implementations take between 4 and 6 weeks depending on the complexity of your current tech stack.

faqs.q: Does it integrate with my existing systems?
faqs.a: Yes. SiteFlow consolidates data from its own modules and exports feeds for BI tools and accounting software such as Tally Prime and Zoho Books.
Pricing is based on annual construction volume. Contact sales for a custom quote.

cta.heading: Ready to accelerate your reporting loops?
cta.body: Bring live site data into every report with SiteFlow.
